items.headline: Sweden's government offices will block ChatGPT and Claude on staff computers
points: Sweden's Government Offices will block the ChatGPT and Claude websites on staff computers, several outlets report.
Staff are being directed to Microsoft Copilot instead, according to Mezha, Notebookcheck and CEOWORLD.
The block also affects Anthropic's Claude; none of the sources quotes OpenAI or Anthropic.
